**ON THE COMPUTATION OF THE DIFFERENCE GALOIS GROUPS OF ORDER THREE EQUATIONS**

*THOMAS DREYFUS AND MARINA POULET*

37 pp, 20 sections.

**Abstract.** In this paper we consider the problem of computing the diﬀerence Galois groups of order three equations for a large class of diﬀerence operators including the shift operator (Case S), the q-diﬀerence operator (Case Q), the Mahler operator (Case M) and the elliptic case (Case E). We show that the general problem can be reduced to several ancillary problems. We prove criteria to detect the irreducible and imprimitive Galois groups. Finally, we give a suﬃcient condition of diﬀerential transcendence of solutions of order three diﬀerence equations. We also compute the diﬀerence Galois group of an equation suggested by Wadim Zudilin.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2.1 Galois groups; Notations and conventions; 2 Difference algebra; 2.2 Factorisations of difference operators; 2.3 From theory to practice; 3 Galois groups of difference systems; 3.1 The reducible case; 3.2 The imprimitive case; 3.3 The primitive case; 4 Galois groups of equations of order one and ; 4.2 Galois groups of diagonal systems; 5 Galois groups of equations of order two; 6.1 Reducible case; 6 Galois groups of equations of order three; 6.2 Imprimitive case; 6.4 Summary
